round: Domain Real-Data Acquisition Sprint (evidence only, domain first, Core frozen)
rules: UNKNOWN means the source does not state it. Nothing marked UNKNOWN was inferred.
A classification is a statement about origin, never about usefulness.
A dataset is REAL_MEASURED only when an instrument recorded it in a documented experiment. A reduction or transcription of measured data is DERIVED unless it is the published raw file.
claim_mapping says what a dataset COULD test. This round tested nothing: no calibration, no UQ, no verdict.
licence.redistribution is PERMITTED only when the licence text read from the repository record grants it. Otherwise the raw bytes are not vendored and the status is EXTERNAL_FETCH_REQUIRED.

status.ALREADY_IN_REPOSITORY: bytes were vendored by an earlier round; not modified here
status.VENDORED: bytes vendored by this round, SHA-256 pinned
status.VENDORABLE_NOT_VENDORED: licence permits redistribution; not vendored this round (scope or size); manifest committed
status.EXTERNAL_FETCH_REQUIRED: redistribution not clearly permitted; only metadata, checksums and acquisition instructions committed
status.CANDIDATE_NOT_ACQUIRED: identified and described; not retrieved or not screened in depth

testable.YES: the required quantities are measured, synchronized and documented
testable.PARTIAL: some required quantities are measured; the rest must be declared, calibrated or are weakly resolved

datasets.equipment: Digatron Firing Circuits Universal Battery Tester, 75 A / 5 V channel; 8 cu.ft. thermal chamber; AD592 case temperature sensor
datasets.protocol: four-pulse HPPC at the SOC levels the readme lists (100, 95, 90, 80, 70, ..., 20, 15, 10, 5, 2.5, 0 %); C/20 discharge and charge; 0.5C, 2C, 1C discharges; UDDS, HWFET, LA92, US06, Mixed 1-8 drive cycles; at 40, 25, 10, 0, -10, -20 degC ambient
datasets.temperature: ambient 40, 25, 10, 0, -10, -20 degC (vendored: 25 degC); case temperature measured
datasets.sampling: 0.1 s during pulses and drive cycles; 10 s or 60 s elsewhere (measured in DATA_QUALITY.json)

channels.chamber_temperature: UNKNOWN - not a column in the LG exports

reasons: units present for every numeric channel; no missing or non-finite values in the five vendored exports
HPPC: 233 exact duplicate rows and 247 repeated Prog Time stamps (logger artifacts) must be dropped by a declared rule
0.5C, 2C and C/20 discharges are logged at 60 s; the 2C file starts 60 s into the step, so the load-onset voltage step is not in it (the HPPC file has 0.1 s pulses for that)
each export carries one NUL byte and CRLF line endings; a parser must read bytes
charge counter uncertainty is not documented
one Mendeley folder (the 0 degC block) mixes a 10degC-labelled .mat with 0degC files; affects temperature labelling of external files only

claim_mapping.how: HPPC pulses give I and V at 0.1 s at each listed SOC level; 0.5C and 2C discharges give loaded V against Ah; C/20 gives a loaded pseudo-OCV curve for the same cell
claim_mapping.limits: the model is discharge-only: HPPC charge pulses are outside the claim; the model has no RC branch, so any pulse-duration dependence is a known unmodelled effect the model's own polarization screen must flag

claim_mapping.how: calibrate on a declared subset of HPPC pulses, predict held-out pulses and the constant-current discharges
measured Ah counter against I integrated over time, with capacity from Cap_1C or C/20
0.5C, 1C, 2C discharges end at the 2.8 V cycler cut-off (screen: minimum voltage 2.79993 V)
claim_mapping.limits: the solver refuses a declared OCV curve together with a cutoff voltage (solver.py: InvalidScientificProblem); runtime with a curve needs a cutoff state of charge or the chord

claim_mapping.how: capacity delivered at C/20, 0.5C, 1C, 2C at one temperature; other temperatures in the external files
case temperature rises from 24.19 to 27.87 degC over the 2C discharge
claim_mapping.limits: heat capacity C and conductance hA are not documented, so they must be calibrated; the +/-1 degC sensor accuracy is comparable to the 3.7 degC rise; entropic heat is outside the model

datasets.held_out_possible: YES - across SOC levels within HPPC, across rates (calibrate on HPPC and C/20, predict 0.5C and 2C), and across temperatures using the external files
missing_information: cell heat capacity and surface conductance
relaxation time after each HPPC pulse is inside the file but no rest-length rationale is documented
